purpose: Compose period Revenue, canonical Cash Bridge, current point-in-time AP, explicit COGS/Operating Cost truth, and gated management profit without inventing missing financial facts.

shape.as_of: caller snapshot as-of or deterministic maximum valid upstream as-of
shape.revenue: canonical Monthly Revenue truth plus coverage
shape.cogs: canonical period COGS Financial Truth or GAP/null
shape.operating_costs: canonical period Operating Costs Financial Truth or GAP/null

rules: Profit is numeric only when Revenue, COGS and Operating Costs are numeric compatible Financial Truth for the exact target period and scope.
Any required NOT_CONNECTED dependency makes Profit NOT_CONNECTED/null.
Otherwise any required GAP dependency makes Profit GAP/null.
Otherwise any ESTIMATE dependency caps derived Profit at ESTIMATE.
Cash Bridge and AP are not Profit dependencies.
Cash movement is not expense recognition and AP is not cash or expense recognition.
The metric is management baseline profit only; it is not statutory/net profit.

component_rules: Revenue preserves canonical Monthly Revenue coverage; incomplete/gross/raw Revenue is never used as fallback.
Cash Bridge is preserved rather than re-calculated when a canonical bridge is supplied. Raw cash inputs may call calculateCashBridge exactly once.
Known evidenced cash sums may remain numeric under partial coverage, but are not period totals.
Computed ending and cash variance retain independent upstream qualities.
AP is point-in-time current-state truth and never participates in period Profit arithmetic.
Current AP is never backdated to target period end; historical snapshot gaps remain gaps.
COGS defaults to GAP/null with COGS_CONSUMPTION_TRUTH_NOT_AVAILABLE unless canonical COGS truth is supplied.
Operating Costs default to GAP/null with OPERATING_COST_TRUTH_NOT_AVAILABLE unless canonical Operating Cost truth is supplied.
Purchases, inventory counts, recipes, AP and cash movement are never used to synthesize COGS or Profit.
Unknown scope never becomes ALL; ALL requires aggregate_proven=true.
Component failure is isolated and cannot erase valid truth from another component.
PARTIAL_FINANCIAL_BASELINE is a completeness status, not a Financial Truth quality.

acceptance_examples.case: Revenue ACTUAL + Cash partial + AP ACTUAL + COGS GAP + OPEX GAP
acceptance_examples.expected: PARTIAL_FINANCIAL_BASELINE; Revenue/AP preserved; known evidenced Cash preserved; Profit GAP/null

acceptance_examples.case: Revenue ACTUAL + COGS ACTUAL + OPEX ACTUAL with exact period/scope
One required Profit dependency is ESTIMATE and none are missing
acceptance_examples.expected: Profit is numeric ESTIMATE, never ACTUAL

acceptance_examples.case: Current AP is newer/different from historical target end
acceptance_examples.expected: AP remains explicitly current point-in-time or upstream HISTORICAL_AP_SNAPSHOT_NOT_AVAILABLE remains GAP; no backdating
